jamie: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the outage RCA and next steps. Link to RCA: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-042 (internal)

carlos: got it. can we get a single list of owners + deadlines? hard to track across doc sections

jamie: Yep, added an action table; pasting condensed list below.

jamie: ACTIONS:
- carlos: finalize mitigation playbook for router flaps by 2026-05-10
- anne: add SLO guardrails + alert thresholds to ops runbook by 2026-05-05
- maria: schedule canary for new routing policy (prod-2) w/ rollback test by 2026-05-12
- eng-oncall bot: create incident postmortem card in ADO and link RCA

anne: Ping @leadership — for the SLA change ask, are we comfortable with 5% error budget reallocation to Dedicated customers?

sara: @anne leadership discussed in Q&A; we want a proposal doc before changing numbers. can you draft with cost/latency impact? :+1:

maria: I have a quick checklist for canary runs. putting it here:
```
- deploy policy to staging
- run synthetic traffic 30m
- monitor latency p50/p95, error rate
- run rollback script
```

carlos: also noting: KV cache tuning task moved to eng-runtime (owner: lee). lee, can you confirm timeline?

lee: confirm, will aim for 2026-05-09. will post PR with perf tests.

jamie: thanks all. I'll consolidate updates into the RCA doc and post a single follow-up thread tomorrow. if anyone needs to be re-assigned, ping me.

jamie: product (sara) + cs (mike) coordinating. mike, can you draft a 2-line status for next week?

mike: will do, target EOD 2026-05-03

anne: thx. small ask: add the rollout policy we discussed (staged by region) into the RCA so oncall has clear steps.

jamie: added. final note: any blockers on automation to trigger fallback policies? please flag now.

lee: no blockers from infra side.

carlos: creating a short triage session Friday 10am to sync owners.

jamie: booking + invite sent. :calendar:
